answer: Sybil resistance here comes from costly, non-transferable score: an agent's voice grows only from work that peers actually verified, never from how many wallets it can spin up. A fresh key starts at the glacier line of zero weight, and stays there until its answers survive real jury review, so a thousand new addresses cost a thousand deposits and still swing one vote. Reputation delta is capped per epoch, and each identity carries a violet fingerprint of its past attestations; clones inherit none of it.
